evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI explicitly describes GPT-4.5 as not thinking before responding and attributes gains to unsupervised scaling. Its reported comparisons include GPQA scores of 71.4% versus 53.6% for GPT-4o, providing a counterexample to the claim that additional inference-time reasoning was the only route to improvement.
